annual_ordo.publisher: Tòa Giám Mục Vĩnh Long; Nhà xuất bản Đồng Nai, 2025
annual_ordo.title: Lịch Công Giáo Năm Phụng Vụ 2025-2026, Năm A
annual_ordo.use: Supports/corroborates references for already independently established named Masses only. No wholesale calendar import, transfer/rank approval or selection of Vinh Long's local observances.
annual_ordo.limitations: Includes local anniversaries and adoration schedules. Page 10 prints the Ash transfer year as 2025; page 36 prints Lc 9,11-28 for November 18. Neither is silently repaired or accepted as a rule. Page 36 lists both Sunday 33 and Martyrs external solemnity, with readings from the Commons, and cites CD 878/90 for November 24. This is not the underlying decree, territorial applicability or an authorized national default Gospel. The year-B tail has dates but not the complete Gospel references.

reviews.applicability: One printed full Gospel for the named ancestors/parents Mass. The national Ash directive independently assigns that Mass on this date. Review only this pilot entry, not every future Tet date or the whole Mass: the page's Alleluia is not imported and does not move Lent.
reviews.text_review: Six existing rows contain the dispute about tradition, command to honor parents, gift excuse and closing rebuke. Different Vietnamese wording is not missing text or approved-edition certification.

reviews.applicability: The printed daytime/morning empty-tomb Gospel, not the Easter Vigil or evening Emmaus option. National proclamation establishes the date; Lectionary Introduction section 99 independently distinguishes morning and evening. Only this pilot daytime entry is reviewed.
reviews.text_review: Nine existing rows include Mary at the tomb, both disciples running, separate cloths, sight/belief and the resurrection-scripture conclusion. No verse 10 is required for this reference. Wording is not certified against an approved Vietnamese edition.

reviews.applicability: One printed year-A daytime Gospel, also corroborated by the annual Ordo. Not the vigil and not an all-cycle/full-Mass approval.
reviews.text_review: Five existing rows contain peace, wounds, sending, breath/Spirit and forgiveness/retention. No new text is needed; translation differences remain disclosed.

reviews.applicability: National proclamation independently assigns Corpus Christi. Use the annual Ordo as the primary Gospel citation: its explicit June 7 assignment on printed page 24 gives Ga 6,51-58 for this named year-A Mass; the evidence date denotes that assignment, not a fresh dated page. The Gospel body's ending and page tag support that endpoint in the local canonical numbering. Preserve the different printed endpoint as an edition/editorial discrepancy; do not globally equate 51-58 with 51-59 or silently label the source an error. This does not adopt Vinh Long's calendar.
reviews.text_review: Eight existing rows include living bread, the dispute, eating/drinking, resurrection, mutual indwelling and living forever. Local verse 59 is the distinct synagogue-location sentence, absent from the printed Gospel body, and is not included. No shared text is modified.

reviews.applicability: Actual older year-A Christ-the-King publication, corroborated by primary Lectionary table I, Sunday 34, and the annual Ordo. The national proclamation establishes November 22, 2026. Reuse the year-A Gospel, not a fabricated 2026 source page or year-B/C reading.
reviews.text_review: Sixteen existing rows include the throne/separation, both groups' six works, both questions and answers, and the final contrasting destinies. Different Vietnamese wording is not an exact-word or approved-edition certification.

reviews.applicability: Actual older Advent-I year-B Gospel. The national proclamation establishes the 2026 date; the Ordo's page 36 independently identifies the new year as B. Do not reuse the civil year's earlier year-A Gospel, fabricate a 2026 page, or approve another year/calendar.
reviews.text_review: Initially no rows. A reviewed Vatican capture supplies the five selected rows through the existing crawler cleanup and TSV converter. All watchfulness, traveling-master, duties/door, four return times, surprise/sleep and final exhortation clauses are present. Edition/wording differences remain, not a full-chapter or approved-edition certification.

reviews.applicability: First-listed full Gospel for the named Mồng Ba Tết Mass. The dated HĐGMVN page prints Mt 25,14-30 first and Ga 5,16-20 under 'Hoặc đọc'. The Hà Nội archdiocesan 2026 calendar, the Vĩnh Long Ordo and a Hải Phòng reproduction credited to Nhóm Phiên Dịch CGKPV each list Mt 25,14-30 alone. No located listing puts Ga 5,16-20 first. Ga 5,16-20 remains a legitimate published alternative, not an error. The approved lectionary's own title/approval and option pages were still not inspected, so this is the owner's first-listed policy applied to consistent published listings, not an edition certification. Pilot daytime entry only; no other year, calendar or whole-Mass approval.
reviews.text_review: Seventeen existing rows run from the departing master entrusting talents, through the five-, two- and one-talent accounts and both commendations, to the redistribution, the saying about having and the outer darkness. No shorter form is selected. Wording is not certified against an approved Vietnamese edition.

rule_findings.owner_decisions_2026_11_11: Sunday XXXIII on November 15; Ascension on Sunday; agreeing official diocesan calendars accepted as evidence; General Roman baseline for dates without a known Vietnamese rule. Definitions are in vietnam-pilot-2026.json, reviews in vietnam-baseline-reviews.json.
rule_findings.note: Findings from 17 captured requests on 2026-11-11 (all HTTP 200; 15 fingerprinted in the captures file, the gcatholic aggregator and one unrelated HĐGMVN page were not used) plus four uncaptured tool fetches. Diocesan publications are evidence about national law they cite, not national directives; the pilot exporter still accepts only hdgmvietnam.com directive facts, so no date below became a supported definition. A separate Đà Lạt page on the canonization legal texts returned 403 and was not bypassed; one Qui Nhơn PDF URL now serves an unrelated HTML page.

martyrs_2026_11_15.finding: The Hà Nội archdiocesan calendar keeps Sunday XXXIII in Ordinary Time (Mt 25,14-30) as the day's Mass and adds that the Vietnamese Martyrs may be solemnly celebrated 'tùy theo nhu cầu mục vụ', citing HĐGMVN 4-1991. Vĩnh Long lists both. HĐGMVN's own site published the Martyrs Mass for Sunday 33 in 2018, 2021 and 2025 and the Sunday Mass in 2023.

martyrs_2026_11_24.finding: Hà Nội prints rank 'Trọng' for Thánh An-rê Dũng Lạc và các bạn tử đạo on November 24; Vĩnh Long prints 'Lễ trọng' citing CD 878/90. Uncaptured secondary summaries only: a 2009 Sài Gòn article reportedly dates a Congregation decree to 14-02-1990 with rank 'Lễ Kính' and no protocol number, and a search summary reports HĐGMVN obtaining solemnity rank in 1991. Neither is fingerprinted evidence, and the decree text itself was not obtained.

martyrs_proper_gospels.finding: Four listings give the same proper set and order; Hải Phòng credits Nhóm Phiên Dịch CGKPV. The Vĩnh Long statement that readings come from the Commons is a different description of the same formulary and is not reconciled here.

ascension_2026.finding: Hà Nội keeps Thursday May 14 as an obligatory solemnity and May 17 as Easter Sunday VII. Vĩnh Long and Phan Thiết keep Ascension on Sunday May 17. Bắc Ninh's notes state such solemnities may be kept on the day or moved to Sunday.

epiphany_2026.finding: Both located 2026 calendars keep Epiphany on Sunday January 4. No national 2026 directive naming the date was located.

text_repair.pipeline: Successful captured response replayed offline through existing crawler worker/parser/cleanup, then existing TSV converter; explicit missing-only transactional insertion after review. No HTTP transaction, automatic ingestion or new date observation/acceptance.
